name: G9 T3 W01 Part 2 - Picture and sound data
description: Picture and sound data. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Fill in Blank. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: One measurement of sound taken at one moment.
words.example: A sample stores one sound measurement from one moment.

words.definition: The number of sound measurements taken each second.
words.example: A sample rate of 8 means eight sound measurements each second in our small example.
